integrity: Derivations are self-contained; numerical series/optimizer checks support but do not replace proof. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp asymptotic as complex mixing tends to zero at fixed Gaussian width and fixed rectangular lattice area 1/2; not uniform in width, not a global mixing-magnitude bound; does not claim uniqueness of crossover.
title: Phase-anisotropic sharp recovery of a singular Hermite Gabor frame
